metadata.dataset: Striver SDE Sheet — original metadata/test data
metadata.note: Descriptions and hints are newly written; third-party editorial/problem text is not reproduced.

problem.title: N-Queens
problem.description: Place n queens on an n by n board so that no two queens attack each other.
hints: Place one queen per row and track used columns and diagonals.

problem.title: Sudoku Solver
problem.description: Fill a partially completed 9x9 Sudoku board so every row, column and box contains digits 1 through 9 exactly once.
hints: Choose an empty cell and try only digits that satisfy its row, column and box.

problem.title: Rat in a Maze
problem.description: Find all valid paths from the top-left to bottom-right of a binary maze.
hints: Move only through open cells and mark the current path to prevent cycles.

problem.title: M-Coloring Problem
problem.description: Determine whether a graph can be colored with at most m colors so adjacent vertices differ.
hints: Assign colors vertex by vertex and reject conflicts.

problem.title: Word Search
problem.description: Determine whether a word can be formed by adjacent grid cells without reusing a cell.
hints: DFS from matching starting cells and mark the current cell as used.

problem.title: Combination Sum III
problem.description: Choose exactly k distinct numbers from 1 through 9 whose sum equals n.
hints: Build combinations in increasing order to avoid duplicates.

problem.title: Palindrome Partitioning
problem.description: Generate every partition of a string where every part is a palindrome.
hints: Try each endpoint and recurse when the selected substring is palindromic.

problem.title: Subsets
problem.description: Generate all subsets of an array of distinct values.
hints: At each position choose to include or exclude the value.

problem.title: Subsets II
problem.description: Generate all unique subsets when the array can contain duplicates.
hints: Sort first and skip equal values at the same recursion depth.

problem.title: Permutations
problem.description: Generate all permutations of distinct values.
hints: Choose one unused value for each position.

problem.title: Permutations II
problem.description: Generate all unique permutations when values may repeat.
hints: Sort values and skip duplicate choices at the same recursion depth.

problem.title: Generate Parentheses
problem.description: Generate all valid strings containing n pairs of parentheses.
hints: Never place more closing brackets than opening brackets used.

problem.title: Letter Combinations of Phone Number
problem.description: Generate all letter strings represented by a sequence of phone keypad digits.
hints: Choose one letter for each digit and recurse.

problem.title: N-Queens II
problem.description: Count the number of distinct ways to place n non-attacking queens.
hints: Use column and diagonal occupancy sets for constant-time conflict checks.

problem.title: Jump Game
problem.description: Determine whether the last index is reachable when each value is the maximum jump length.
hints: Track the farthest reachable position.

problem.title: Jump Game II
problem.description: Find the minimum number of jumps needed to reach the final index.
hints: Expand the current reachable range and count a jump when the range ends.

problem.title: Gas Station
problem.description: Find a starting station from which a circular route can be completed, or return -1.
hints: If total gas is insufficient no solution exists; reset the candidate after a negative running balance.

problem.title: Candy
problem.description: Assign at least one candy to each child while respecting higher ratings and minimizing total candies.
hints: Use left-to-right and right-to-left constraints.

problem.title: Assign Cookies
problem.description: Maximize satisfied children by assigning at most one cookie per child.
hints: Sort greed factors and cookie sizes and greedily match the smallest feasible cookie.

expectedComplexity.time: O(n log n + m log m)

problem.title: Lemonade Change
problem.description: Determine whether every customer can receive correct change when each item costs 5.
hints: Prefer larger bills for making 15 change while preserving smaller bills.

problem.title: Fractional Knapsack
problem.description: Maximize value in a capacity-limited knapsack when fractions are allowed.
hints: Take items in decreasing value-to-weight ratio.

problem.title: Job Sequencing Problem
problem.description: Schedule jobs with deadlines and profits to maximize profit, one job per slot.
hints: Sort by profit and place each job in the latest available slot.

expectedComplexity.time: O(n log n) with efficient slots

problem.title: Minimum Platforms
problem.description: Find the minimum platforms needed so no train waits.
hints: Sort arrivals and departures and sweep both arrays.

problem.title: N Meetings in One Room
problem.description: Select the maximum number of non-overlapping meetings.
hints: Choose compatible meetings by earliest finishing time.

problem.title: Maximum Activities
problem.description: Choose the largest possible set of mutually compatible activities.
hints: Sort by finishing time and greedily accept compatible activities.

problem.title: Find Minimum Number of Coins
problem.description: For standard canonical denominations, find the minimum number of coins needed to form an amount.
hints: Take the largest denomination that does not exceed the remaining amount.

problem.title: Merge Intervals
problem.description: Merge overlapping intervals into disjoint ranges.
hints: Sort by start time and extend the current merged interval when overlap exists.

problem.title: Insert Interval
problem.description: Insert a new interval into sorted non-overlapping intervals and merge overlaps.
hints: Append intervals before the new interval, merge overlaps, then append the remainder.

problem.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
problem.description: Remove the minimum number of intervals so the remainder do not overlap.
hints: Keep intervals with the earliest finishing times.

problem.title: Meeting Rooms II
problem.description: Find the minimum number of rooms needed for all meetings.
hints: Use sorted starts and ends or a min-heap of active end times.

problem.title: Minimum Window Substring
problem.description: Find the shortest substring containing all characters of a target string with required multiplicities.
hints: Expand until valid, then shrink while preserving validity.

problem.title: Longest Repeating Character Replacement
problem.description: Find the longest substring that can be made uniform using at most k replacements.
hints: Maintain the most frequent character count in the current window.

problem.title: Count Number of Nice Subarrays
problem.description: Count subarrays containing exactly k odd numbers.
hints: Use prefix counts or the at-most-k transformation.

problem.title: Subarray with Given XOR
problem.description: Count subarrays whose XOR equals a target K.
hints: For each prefix XOR, look for prior prefixXor XOR K.

problem.title: Longest Subarray with Sum K
problem.description: Find the longest contiguous subarray whose sum equals K.
hints: Store the earliest index of each prefix sum.

problem.title: Count Inversions
problem.description: Count pairs i<j where a[i] > a[j].
hints: Count cross-half inversions during merge.

problem.title: Reverse Pairs
problem.description: Count pairs i<j where a[i] > 2*a[j].
hints: Count valid cross-half pairs before merging sorted halves.

problem.title: Kth Largest Element
problem.description: Find the kth largest value in an unsorted array.
hints: A min-heap of size k or quickselect can solve the selection problem.

problem.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problem.description: Return the k most frequent values.
hints: Count frequencies and keep the best k values with a heap or buckets.

problem.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
problem.description: Merge k sorted linked lists into one sorted list.
hints: Use a min-heap containing the current head of each list.

problem.title: Median of Data Stream
problem.description: Support insertion of numbers and retrieval of the median efficiently.
hints: Keep lower values in a max-heap and upper values in a min-heap.
